'''Akritas Chlorakas''' ({{langx|el|Ακρίτας Χλώρακας}}) is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Chlorakas|Chloraka]], [[Paphos District|Paphos]]. The club was founded in 1971 and currently plays in the [[Cypriot First Division]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Προκήρυξη Πρωταθλήματος Cyta 2022 - 2023 |url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/44634 |access-date=2022-08-05 |website=www.cfa.com.cy}}</ref> Akritas' colours are green and white, and they play their home games at the [[Chloraka Municipal Stadium]]. The club is owned by Lithuanian investor Liutauras Varanavičius.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-08-18 |title=Limassol second-tier club gets Russian YouTuber makeover |url=https://www.financialmirror.com/2022/08/18/limassol-second-tier-club-gets-russian-youtuber-makeover/ |access-date=2023-07-31 |website=Financial Mirror}}</ref>"}}
